note: Captured from the CHR test router. The pools were created FOR the capture, with documentation-range addresses (TEST-NET-2, RFC 5737), so nothing here describes a real network. What is real is the router's own reply: which fields /ip/pool returns, including the read-only total/used/available, and how it spells them. tools/capture-fixtures.js drives the Node collectors and cannot capture an area, so this was read through /ip/pool/print and written in the same shape.
